visual_design: Original role diagram uses explicit scored/aligned labels with definition arrows, a common unarrowed bracket for the two aliases of one crosslink, and separate evidence/overlay notes. No recovered matrix values, protein contours or experimental markers are fabricated. Secondary quantity distinctions and complete computable-mapping limits accompany the figure in its caption.
transferable_rules: Name the scored entity and reference frame before assigning axes or interpreting a matrix. Map notation by scientific role; do not infer an executable transpose. A duplicated symmetric overlay does not establish symmetry of its underlying quantity.

Separate expected error, physical distance, local confidence, categorical identity and experiment-specific restraint predicates. A satisfied restraint is bounded evidence, not proof of global structure correctness.
